description: This file contains helper functions for a Flask web application, including response handling, URL generation, flashing messages, and file sending utilities.

methods.name: get_debug_flag
methods.description: Determines if Flask app debug mode is enabled based on environment variable 'FLASK_DEBUG'.

methods.name: get_load_dotenv
methods.description: Checks if default dotenv files should be loaded based on 'FLASK_SKIP_DOTENV' environment variable.

methods.name: stream_with_context
methods.description: Decorator/function to wrap a generator or function so it runs within the current Flask request context, preserving request, session, and g.

methods.name: make_response
methods.description: Creates a Flask Response object from view return values, allowing headers to be added.

methods.name: url_for
methods.description: Generates a URL for a given endpoint with specified values, considering active request or app context.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Creates a redirect response, using current_app.redirect if available, otherwise Werkzeug's redirect.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Raises an HTTPException for a given status code, using current_app.aborter if available.

methods.name: get_template_attribute
methods.description: Loads a macro or variable from a template to invoke from Python code.

methods.name: flash
methods.description: Flashes a message to the session for display on the next request, with optional category.

methods.name: get_flashed_messages
methods.description: Retrieves flashed messages from the session, optionally filtered by category and with categories included.

methods.name: send_file
methods.description: Sends a file to the client, supporting file paths and file-like objects, with options for caching, MIME type, and headers.

methods.name: send_from_directory
methods.description: Sends a file from within a specified directory, ensuring security via safe join.

methods.name: get_root_path
methods.description: Finds the root path of a package or module, or returns current working directory if not found.

methods.name: _split_blueprint_path
methods.description: Splits a dotted blueprint name into its components, cached for efficiency.
